attributes.name: Tara
attributes.descriptionText:
Tara is still learning how to trust the world. She's not the kind of cat who’ll jump into your lap on day one—but give her time, patience, and respect, and you’ll be rewarded with a quiet, loyal companion.

Tara is most comfortable when she has all four paws on the ground. You'll see her confidence grow when she's walking freely around the room. She's a bit defensive when tucked away in a cat tree or bed, so it’s best to let her come to you rather than making the first move. Slow and steady is the way to Tara’s heart.

She would thrive in a home with someone who has experience with shy cats—someone who understands that trust takes time. Once she feels safe, Tara truly enjoys being petted and even seeks it out on her own terms. One of her favorite activities? Chasing the laser pointer! It’s a great way to bond with her while keeping her active and engaged.

Tara doesn’t seem particularly interested in other cats—she’s indifferent, really—so she could do well as a solo cat or in a quiet multi-cat home where she has her own space.

Tara may not be the right fit for every home, but for the right person—someone calm, patient, and kind—she could be an incredibly rewarding companion.

attributes.name: Buttercup
Jax
Aurelia
attributes.descriptionText:
Birthday: May 1, 2016

Aurelia is a gorgeous lady with luxurious, silky-soft fur, a little bit of sass, and a whole lot of love to give. After spending her entire life with one family, she's looking for a peaceful retirement home where she can settle in and be cherished.

Aurelia was surrendered after her family brought home a new kitten that she simply couldn't adjust to. After ten years in the same home, it was a huge change for this sweet girl. She's ready to find a forever family that understands her and will love her just as she is.

This beautiful girl enjoys having her people nearby and loves being part of the action. While she isn't necessarily a full-time lap cat, she's definitely lap adjacent—happy to curl up beside you on the couch and keep you company. Affection is important to Aurelia, but she prefers it on her own terms. When she's in the mood for attention, she'll happily accept pets and has the cutest way of showing her appreciation: she'll shower you with repeated little licks to let you know just how happy she is.

Aurelia would do best as the only cat in the home or with one older, respectful feline companion who understands personal space. Kittens and energetic cats simply aren't her style.

She does have a medical condition that makes her prone to occasional sores around her mouth and face, but it's very well managed with daily medication. In fact, she's one of the easiest cats to give a pill to—she takes her medicine like an absolute champ! With her medication, her condition is easily controlled and doesn't stop her from enjoying life.

Because of her long, beautiful coat, Aurelia will also need regular grooming and occasional shaving to prevent painful mats from forming. She'll look and feel her best with a little extra coat maintenance.

If you're looking for a loyal companion who will keep you company, make you smile with her sweet little kisses, and appreciate a quiet, loving home, Aurelia is ready to spend her golden years with you. She has so much love left to give and is hoping her next forever home truly lasts forever.

Aurelia's adoption donation is $75 which includes age-appropriate vaccines, dewormer, flea treatment, Felv/FIV testing, microchip, and spay. 

If you would like more information on Aurelia, please contact Kirsten at lovingcarecatrescue@gmail.com. If you would like to fill out an online application, please visit https://alovingcarecatrescue.org/adoptionapplicationonline.html

Please note:  LCCR does not allow our adopted cats and kittens to be declawed.  All adopted kitties are to be kept as indoor-only pets.

attributes.descriptionText:
Meet Chase!


Chase is a sweet, independent guy with a curious side. He loves to explore his surroundings and to investigate what’s going on around him. When he’s ready for some affection, Chase will flop down on his side and ask for belly rubs.


Chase is great about using his scratching box and loves playing with his dragon toy. He appreciates having quiet places to retreat to when he wants some alone time or a nap. At night he loves to sleep on the bed with his people.


Chase would do best as the only cat in the home so he can have all the attention, love, and space to call his own. He’s looking for someone who will appreciate his independent streak while also enjoying his affectionate, sometimes-insistent personality.


If you’re looking for a sweet, independent kitty, Chase might just be your perfect match.

attributes.name: Savannah
Bug
attributes.descriptionText:
Meet Bug — An 11-Year-Old Gentleman With Personality to Spare!

Bug is 11 years old, and this handsome Doberman/Husky mix has perfected the art of enjoying the good life.

Affectionately called “Bugger,” he knows exactly what he likes: time outside, a comfy place to relax, his people nearby, and—most importantly—a really good neck scratch!

❤️ A Few Things to Know About Bug



 Sweet & affectionate — Bug loves meeting adults and is always happy to make a new friend.


 Professional snuggler — Expect a sniff, a lick, and a classic Doberman lean. And if you stop petting too soon, Bug may remind you!


 Loves the outdoors — A securely fenced yard is a must. He enjoys running and exploring.


 Smart guy — He knows sit, stay, lie down, off, and go to bed.


 Great traveler — He rides well in the car and is wonderful at the vet, including nail trims.


 Simple tastes — Give him a filled bone and he's a happy guy.


 Mellow & easygoing — Bug thrives with a calm, predictable routine.



And then there's Bug's... culinary career. 

This gentleman has been known to counter-surf and has even helped himself to an entire roast! His future family will need to keep food safely out of reach and the trash securely locked.

 Bug's Best Match

Bug would do best in a quiet home with adults or older children 13+. Young children make him nervous, so his history and household suitability should be discussed with Doberman Rescue Minnesota.

He has lived with another dog but is not a good match for other large male dogs. Dog introductions and compatibility will need to be carefully assessed.

His previous family reported that he did well with cats, generally ignoring them or accepting their cuddles.

A securely fenced yard is required, and secure latches are important—Bug has discovered that some gates can be opened with a determined nose! His recall when loose is unreliable.

Bug is house-trained and comfortable in a gated area. He isn't comfortable in a crate and hasn't used one in years. He also has mild separation anxiety that will benefit from continued patience and support.

 Why Bug?

Because sometimes the best dogs aren't looking for a million adventures.

They're looking for a soft place to land.

A yard to explore.
A comfy bed.
A person to lean against.
A filled bone.
And someone who understands that dinner should never, ever be late.

At 11 years old, Bug has plenty of love left to give—and plenty of personality to share.

If you're looking for a distinguished gentleman with a soft heart, a mischievous streak, and an excellent appreciation for neck scratches, Bug just might be your guy. ❤️

Contact Doberman Rescue Minnesota to learn more about Bug and whether your home could be his perfect next chapter.

attributes.name: Kesha
attributes.descriptionText:
NEW RESCUE! #womancrushwednesday #wcw
Hi friends! My name is Kesha I’m a 10 year old, 40-pound Pit Bull mix, and I know that “10 years old” might scare some people away… but I promise you I still have SO much life, happiness and love to give. ❤️

I LOVE people, I greet new friends with a bark what means “hi who are you” then a couple seconds I’m on your lap asking for cuddles! Honestly, my favorite place in the whole world is right next to my person. Did someone say cuddles?!  Because I’m always ready for them! I just want to be close to my humans and soak up all the love.
I also LOVE toys, especially the ones that SQUEAK!  If it squeaks, I’m probably going to be obsessed with it. 

Car rides? YES PLEASE!  Walks? EVEN BETTER!  But please don’t pull out a leash unless you’re 100% planning on taking me because I get SO excited when I see one! I know exactly what that leash means and I’m an amazing walker once we’re out and about.

I am also quite possibly the happiest girl you’ll ever meet! I get the zoomies at least twice a day… although my foster family would probably argue it’s more like three times. ❤️ Tell me how cute I am? You come home from work? My human wakes up in the morning? ZOOMIES!!! I just have so much happiness to share! And I’m a social girl!  I get along great with dogs of all ages and sizes, so I’d be happy to have some furry friends or would be just fine being the only child.
I’m also fully potty trained and crate trained, although I don’t really need my crate. I can be left loose in the house for hours and I’ll be a good girl.  I’m smart, too! I already know sit, lay down, and shake.  I’m happy to show off my tricks, especially if there’s a treat involved! 
So, if you’re looking at my age and thinking I’m “too old,” I hope you’ll look a little closer. ❤️ I may have a few more years under my belt, but I have a young at heart personality, a happy little zoomie button, and SO much love to give.

All I’m looking for is someone who will let me spend my golden years doing what I love most: being loved, going on walks, squeaky-toy hunting, showing off my tricks, and cuddling my people. ❤️ apply to meet at https://bit.ly/RRAdoptionApplication

attributes.name: Cinnamon
Sarah
Harrison
attributes.descriptionText:
Harrison DOB - 1/6/2015 American Staffordshire Terrier
Meet Harrison!
Harrison's journey is one of courage and transformation. Rescued after being confiscated in a heartbreaking abuse case and later transferred to Hope for Rehabilitation, he has overcome significant challenges with time and care. While his past has left him initially wary of teenage and adult males, through gentle and patient bonding with dedicated male volunteers, he is learning to trust.
This sweet, house-trained companion does well with most dogs on outings but prefers to be the only dog at home, as he loves giving (and receiving) undivided attention from his family. Known for his excellent manners, snuggly nature, and unwavering loyalty, Harrison seeks a calm, loving environment without cats where his unique needs can be met.
Harrison is ready to begin a new chapter—one filled with gentle care, consistent routines, and plenty of cuddle sessions. If you’re looking for a resilient soul who will fill your home with warmth and love, Harrison might just be your perfect match.

attributes.about: We are an all volunteer rescue organization. We rescue animals, we rehabilitate them, care for them and find them a better suited home. There are far too many homeless or abandoned animals, and  since they have no voice we are their voice, they need our help.

attributes.name: CatRangers
attributes.adoptionProcess: Application, contract which requires virtual home visit and or home delivery. Adoption fees range from $125-175 and include spay/neuter, FELV/FIV testing, vaccines and microchip.
attributes.about: Cat Rangers was founded under the Center for the Advancement of Higher Knowledge as a rescue organization that assists and rescues cats and kittens in crisis, whether in a shelter, abandoned or otherwise homeless. We provide these homeless kittys with medical care and a safe place to live while looking for their furever homes. We have rescued thousands of wayward kitties over the past 6 years. Our mission is to assist as many "last chance" kitties and animal loving humans as possible.

attributes.name: Kitty Katchers
attributes.adoptionProcess: We screen applicants very closely, including a visit to the future home of cat, after completion of application.  After approval, a contract is signed and a fee of $130 per kitten and $75 per adult cat is charged which includes spay/neuter and all vaccinations.
attributes.about: Kitty Katchers began in the Spring of 2007 to T-N-R cats in the neighborhood.  We get calls constantly to assist in trapping.  Kitty Katchers will trap, spay/neuter and return the feral cats to their own colonies; however, if the female has kittens, we will foster the kittens (including taking care of all vaccinations, illnesses, etc.)  and place them up for adoption.  By practicing the TNR method, we are hoping to assist in the control of the feral cat population.

attributes.name: Safe Harbor Equine and Livestock Sanctuary
attributes.adoptionProcess: Our adoption process includes an adoption application, vet reference check, farrier reference check, and adoption fee.  Our adoption contract is a lifelong adoption contract.
attributes.about: We are a team of dedicated equine advocates who seek to improve the quality of life for the animals in our area through outreach, education, rescue, rehabilitation, and rehoming.

attributes.name: Boston Terrier Rescue of North Texas
attributes.adoptionProcess: All potential adopters must fill out an application.  The applicant must give a vet reference and a personal reference.  Both of these references will be checked.  All current pets of a potential adopter must be current on shots, spay/neuter and current on heartworm prevention.  Once approved we then conduct a home visit to ensure it is a good placement for one of our dogs.  All potential adopters must have a fenced yard or have arrangements for walking the dog regularily.
attributes.about: Boston Terrier Rescue of North Texas is a rescue group focused on rescuing Boston Terriers in need.  We love the breed and do whatever possible to help any Boston Terrier in need regardless of age or medical condition.

attributes.name: Loving Care Cat Rescue
attributes.adoptionProcess: Adoption applications are processed.  Approved adopters can receive their cats after they are spayed/neutered.  Fees vary depend upon age of cat and breed.  There is an adoption contract.
attributes.about: We are a network of foster homes located throughout central Pennsylvania dedicated to assisting cats who need homes.

attributes.name: The Kitten Nursery
attributes.adoptionProcess:
1. Fill out an online application. 
2. We may contact your vet to get a reference check, verifying all present pets are up to date on vaccines and are spayed/neutered. 
3. A phone/email interview will do conducted to see which cat(s) would be the best match for your household. 
4. A meet and greet of the cat(s) of interest will be arranged. 
5. Adoption contract signed, if applicable a spay/neuter contract signed and adoption fee collected. 

NOTE: The Kitten Nursery does not adopt out on a first come, first serve basis. Our goal is to find the best possibly match between applicant and cat.

Adoption fees: $50 for first cat, $25 for second cat.  $20 sterilization deposit on all kittens that are too young to be spayed/neutered before adoption.
attributes.about: The Kitten Nursery is a no-kill rescue based in Williamston, MI. We are a 501(c)(3) organization whose mission is to save cats/kittens who have no where to go. We consist of a group of volunteers dedicated to providing a loving, safe environment for our cats/kittens until they find their new fur-ever home. The Kitten Nursery relies on the donations from people like you to continue to save cats/kittens.

attributes.name: Ok Save A Dog

attributes.name: Saving Tails Animal Rescue
attributes.adoptionProcess: Interested adopters must first fill out an application. We then conduct a vet checks and review applications. We work hard to find a match for both the family and the animals. If your application is selected, we will set up a meet and greet, followed by adoption if it is a fit! At the adoption, we will fill out the contract and collect the adoption fee Fee is payable by check, cash, credit card or PayPal.
attributes.about: Saving Tails Animal Rescue is a group of dedicated volunteers that work hard to rescue animals from various situations and get them fixed up and into forever homes. Our outreach portion helps the owned chained dogs in the Flint, MI area by providing insulated dog houses, straw, spays and neuters and educating owners on better animal ownership practices. If dogs are surrendered to us through our outreach program, then we take them in, get them healthy and into forever homes.

Doberman Rescue Minnesota
attributes.adoptionProcess:

attributes.about:
Doberman Rescue Minnesota (DRM) is an all-volunteer nonprofit 501(c)(3) rescue organization that was founded in 2000. Dobermans in our program always live in private homes with foster families so we can provide the best care possible and make recommendations on the best type of forever home. We care about the quality of life for all Dobermans as we do our own dogs. In 2015 alone, DRM placed over eighty Dobermans in loving forever homes â our biggest year to date! 

Our mission is to mission rescue and re-home abandoned, neglected and abused Dobermans in need and educate the public about the Doberman breed.
